rows.text: 液压回路中，踏板使制动液产生压力，制动液将压力传到车轮制动分泵。
evidence: https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-5.pdf, hydraulic brakes: il liquido in pressione raggiunge i cilindri delle ruote.

rows.text: 压缩机将压缩空气充入储气罐，回路利用这些空气驱动制动器。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore comprime aria, accumulata nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: aria dal serbatoio aziona i freni.

rows.text: 空气被压缩并储存在储气罐中，然后送往制动气室。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore comprime aria, accumulata nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: aria dal serbatoio aziona i freni.

rows.text: 气压制动系统的储气罐储存的是压缩空气，而不是用于制动的油。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore comprime aria, accumulata nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: aria dal serbatoio aziona i freni.

rows.text: 气压作用于制动气室的膜片，膜片带动制动操纵机构。
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Brake Chambers and Slack Adjusters: la pressione sposta la membrana e l’asta di comando.

rows.text: 防冻装置向空气中加入蒸气，减少回路中水分结冰的可能。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Alcohol evaporator: il vapore di alcol si miscela all’umidità e ne riduce la tendenza a congelare; https://www.nsndepot.com/Files/library/TM/M915/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2.pdf, p. 169, AE-1: il vapore entra nel circuito per contrastare il congelamento dell’umidità.

rows.text: 仪表板上的压力表显示制动回路储气罐中的气压。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: 机油压力表显示发动机机油的压力；气压制动系统的压力表显示空气压力。
evidence: https://downloads.regulations.gov/NHTSA-2018-0067-12550/attachment_8.pdf, Instruments and controls 2-11, Engine oil pressure gauge: pressione della lubrificazione motore; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge: pressione dell’aria nei serbatoi di servizio.

rows.text: 气压制动器的压力表显示储气罐中的气压，而不是水压。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: 压力表显示的异常压降可能表明存在故障，例如漏气。
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Gauges: variazioni insolite di pressione sono rilevabili; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/inspecting-air-brake-system-operation, air loss test: controllo della perdita di pressione.

rows.text: 题库标为正确。压力表显示受监测的行车制动回路储气压力；可以使用两个独立仪表，也可以使用一个双指针仪表。这并不保证每个供气或辅助储气筒都有独立显示。
evidence: Official CQC question 31209 printed VERO says each brake-circuit reservoir has a pressure-gauge indication. Interpreting this as the monitored service-circuit reservoirs is a scope qualification, not verified official intent.

Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, air supply subsystem https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem — wet supply and two service reservoirs; separate gauges or one dual-needle gauge for service pressures. Ontario technical guidance, not Italian equipment law.

US 49 CFR 571.121 §§S5.1.2 and S5.1.4 https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.121 — separate supply reservoir and service-system pressure indicators in covered US vehicles; not an Italian legal requirement.

rows.text: 压力表可用于检查行车制动回路储气罐中储存的空气压力。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: 空气可以被压缩：压缩机使空气增压，储存的压缩空气驱动制动器。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore forza l’aria in uno spazio minore e la immagazzina nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: l’aria in pressione aziona i freni.

rows.text: 驾驶员将显示的压力与车辆规定的工作压力范围进行比较。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: controllo della pressione e intervallo di funzionamento; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/inspecting-air-brake-system-operation, governor test: verifica delle pressioni di intervento e arresto.

rows.text: 压力表测量的是空气压力，而不是温度。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: 空气压力表监测气压制动回路的压力，而不是发动机冷却系统的工作状况。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: 压缩机吸入并压缩空气以供应储气罐；它不靠压缩油来驱动制动器。
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il compressore aspira e comprime aria nel cilindro, la invia al serbatoio ed è azionato dal motore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

rows.text: 压缩机吸入空气并将其压缩，再送入系统的储气罐。
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il compressore aspira e comprime aria nel cilindro, la invia al serbatoio ed è azionato dal motore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

rows.text: 压缩机通过传动部件从发动机曲轴获得动力，例如皮带和皮带轮或齿轮。
evidence: https://patents.google.com/patent/US4129404A/en, Description: compressore per autocarro azionato dall’albero motore mediante cinghie o ingranaggi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il motore aziona il compressore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

rows.text: 压缩机由发动机驱动，而不是由将动力传向车轮的传动轴驱动。
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il compressore aspira e comprime aria nel cilindro, la invia al serbatoio ed è azionato dal motore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76/html/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76.htm, power transmission: albero di trasmissione verso differenziale e ruote.

rows.text: 行星齿轮和半轴齿轮属于差速器。空气压缩机通常采用活塞在气缸内运动来压缩空气。
evidence: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Curriculum21/publication/srsec/804-Automotive_Handbook.pdf, pp. 63–64, Differential Assembly e Operation: ingranaggi sun e pinion (planet wheel) nel differenziale; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: pistone nel cilindro comprime aria.

rows.text: 空气净化器处理压缩空气，在其进入回路前去除水分和油粒等污染物。
evidence: https://www.bendix.com/media/2021/bendix-launches-ad-hfi-air-dryer-with-electronic-pressure-control-capabilities.pdf, PuraGuard: filtro separa gocce d’olio dall’aria compressa; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air dryer: rimozione dell’umidità.

rows.text: 压力表显示空气压力，而不是储气罐中杂质的数量。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: 防冻装置作用于回路空气中的水分以减少结冰，并不作用于转换器中的油。
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Alcohol evaporator: il vapore di alcol si miscela all’umidità e ne riduce la tendenza a congelare; https://www.nsndepot.com/Files/library/TM/M915/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2.pdf, p. 169, AE-1: il vapore entra nel circuito per contrastare il congelamento dell’umidità.

rows.text: 净化器处理压缩空气及其中的污染物，而不是转换器中的油。
evidence: https://www.bendix.com/media/2021/bendix-launches-ad-hfi-air-dryer-with-electronic-pressure-control-capabilities.pdf, PuraGuard: filtro separa gocce d’olio dall’aria compressa; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air dryer: rimozione dell’umidità.

source_access_notes: Independently inspected Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook air supply subsystem, including service reservoir gauges, dual needles, alcohol evaporator and air dryer, and Newfoundland and Labrador Air Brake Manual compressor and reservoir sections. Manufacturer and California Highway Patrol cited technical guidance checked. 31209 service-circuit interpretation and non-individual-monitoring qualification do not assert that the official intended interpretation is proven. Canadian instructional sources are not Italian equipment law.

issues.reason: Il quesito VERO attribuisce al manometro la pressione di ciascun serbatoio del circuito frenante; le fonti consultate indicano i serbatoi primario e secondario o il serbatoio principale, non dimostrano che sia indicata anche la pressione di ogni ulteriore serbatoio, incluso quello di alimentazione. Occorre chiarire l’ambito inteso dal quesito.

https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Gauges: pressione nel sistema del serbatoio principale; non stabilisce indicazione di ogni serbatoio.
